thread:
mike.t: FYI scheduling a very small on-prod migration in the 00:30 UTC change window — adding an index on users(email_domain) to speed signup lookups. expect ~90s quiesce for the table lock.

deploy-bot: Deploy queued: migration=20260321_add_users_email_domain_idx, mode=online, target=prod, window=2026-03-21T00:30Z-00:40Z. Lease requested: db-migration-lease-42.

sara: Do we have a backfill? can we avoid full table scan?

mike.t: Backfill will be chunked async via job service (jobs will use WHERE id % 16 = <shard>) to avoid long locks. The DDL itself is CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY but postgres still takes short-access share locks. plan: 1) pin app version 1.14.2 2) quiesce write path for 90s, 3) apply CONCURRENTLY index, 4) resume.

jordan: Releasing note: pin 1.14.2 -> rollback command documented. If we hit lock wait > 2m or replication lag spikes, abort.

ops-ci: Quick check before we proceed: psql check to monitor lock wait: 
```
SELECT now(), pid, mode, waiting, query FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE state <> 'idle' AND query LIKE '%CREATE INDEX%';
```
Add that to runbook.

sara: ACK. I'll be on watch during the window. if we see >5% latency or >1000ms p99 for write RPCs, we abort. Who is sending the quiesce?

mike.t: I'll flip the feature-flag write_block for signup service and post the exact curl.

mike.t: curl -X POST https://ff.redwood/api/toggle -d '{"flag":"signup_write_block","value":true,"actor":"release"}'

deploy-bot: Holdpoint set at lease-acquire. Remember to run canary route (region eu-west-1) first: 20 req/s for 2m. Deploybot will not handoff lease until both canary checks pass.

sara: canary ok in eu-west-1, p50/p95 look good. ready for main.

jordan: rolling out now. pinning app versions: 1.14.2 -> 1.14.2 (pinned on 40 nodes).

deploy-bot: Migration started: migration=20260321_add_users_email_domain_idx, pid=87231. Watch logs at https://logs.redwood/migrations/87231.

mike.t: starting quiesce in 10s. will post start and end markers. all hands watch p99 and replication lag.

sara: start: 1715501244. p99 writes = 420ms baseline.

mike.t: CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY statement issued.

ops-ci: Replication lag stayed < 200ms. lock wait spikes transient ~30s.

mike.t: done applying index, waiting for REINDEX cleanup, unquiescing now. end: 1715501298.

sara: unquiesced. p99 back to 390ms. no errors in jobs.

jordan: running async backfill with 16 shards, rate-limit 100r/s. backfill job_id=bf-20260321-01.

deploy-bot: Migration complete: success. post-deploy checks passed.

mike.t: Followup runbook: keep the index in read-only for 24h monitoring, then remove pin in 48h if stable. If any regression, rollback path: 1) pause backfill, 2) set signup_write_block=true, 3) drop index via immediate safe-drop job. Command: psql -c 'DROP INDEX IF EXISTS users_email_domain_idx'

sara: noted. marking this thread resolved. :thumbsup:"
